name: Bátonyterenye (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Bátonyterenye (a red and black shield with yellow charges, with a helm, a stag crest and black and yellow mantling) above the name BÁTONYTERENYE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bátonyterenye arms with helm, crest and mantling
